# Mayank Bansal

> just an engineer trying to create things that matter. currently available for hire: part-time, contract or full-time.

i've worked with early-stage teams, moving between frontend, backend, and deployments wherever the product needed me.

i'm currently running a bunch of experiments to see how far i can push myself, and what i can build with models.

mostly write typescript and java. day to day that means next.js, nest.js, spring boot, postgres, redis and docker.

## experience

- evol (sde, feb '26 - oct '26, hyderabad): built an internal ops platform used by ~20 people, a voice and chat assistant on livekit, and a langgraph workflow for jewelry designs.
- echio (sde intern -> sde, may '24 - nov '25, remote): built an hls transcoding pipeline, cut api latency by 50% with redis caching, and cut ci/cd build times by over 50%.
- real dev squad (volunteer sde, aug '24 - aug '26, remote): migrated legacy features to ember.js, built an mcp server for internal apis, and led four devs on a genai revamp.
- [full work history](https://www.mayank.fyi/work)

## projects

- [snip](https://snip.mayank.fyi): a simple editor for small potato stuff. free, no watermarks, works offline.
- [common](https://www.usecommon.app): a common space for you, your people and your agents.
- [shift-read](https://shft.page): a focused reader that translates any article while preserving its structure and formatting.
- [chess with llm](https://chess.mayank.fyi/): a chess arena for playing legal, timed matches against open-weight LLMs.
- [wavmo playground](https://docs.mayank.fyi): an agentic writing workspace that plans, drafts, reviews, and improves technical documents.
- [sketchicon](https://sketchicon.com): 1,700+ deterministic, customizable hand-drawn SVG icons for React.
- [everything else on github](https://github.com/MayankBansal12?tab=repositories)
